name: Mysterious na Kare
source:
A mysterious guy.

[SPOILER]He is an alien who cannot speak a language perceivable to humans (or at least, Mofuko). In the sequel, "Suki na Otoko no Ko?", Mofuko nicknames him "キーテスゴア王子 (Kiitesugoa Ouji; Kiitesugoa Prince)".[/SPOILER]
